svg.text: STAGE 443 · TOPIC 83 · P879 / P880 🎉 · 85TH FAQ 🎉 · 885 TESTS 🎉
Enterprise SIP/IMS RFC 3312 / RFC 4032 Preconditions Anti-Ghost-Ringing & QCI-1 Timeout Guard
企业 SIP/IMS RFC 3312/4032 Preconditions [2,2] 双向就绪防幽灵振铃与 QCI=1 [1500,5000]ms 超时门禁（🎉 P880、第 85 篇 FAQ 与 885 单测三重里程碑）
1. Precondition [2, 2]-Direction Alerting Gate (P879)
• 痛点：在 a=curr:qos local none 时提前发送 180/200 OK 导致幽灵振铃与吞字
• 齐备门禁：强制 local 与 remote [2, 2] 双向均达 sendrecv 后才解锁振铃与 TTS
❌ Premature: 180 Ringing / 200 OK sent while curr:qos=none -> 5 clipped calls
✅ P879 Gate: Suppress 180/200 Until All [2, 2] Directions Reach sendrecv
Action: suppress_180_ringing_until_curr_qos_sendrecv_satisfied
确定性收敛指标（P879）：
✔ clampedGhostRingingOrClippedAnswerCalls = 0（0 幽灵振铃或首句吞字呼叫）
✔ clampedRequiredPreconditionConfirmDirections ∈ [2, 2]（双向确认齐备锁）
2. QCI-1 [1500, 5000]ms Timeout & SIP 580 Gate (P880 🎉)
• 痛点：弱网基站丢失确认 UPDATE，导致呼叫无限卡死在 183 耗尽并发槽位
• 快败降级：将预留超时钳制在 [1500, 5000]ms，超时即回 SIP 580 或降级接通
❌ Hang: 45000ms reservation wait stalls 8 half-open 183 trunk channels
✅ P880 Gate: Clamp Reservation Timeout to [1500, 5000]ms + Fast SIP 580
Action: downgrade_to_best_effort_or_fail_fast_with_sip_580_within_budget
确定性收敛指标（P880 🎉）：
✔ clampedHungPreconditionSetupCalls = 0（0 预留挂起死锁外呼通道）
✔ clampedPreconditionReservationTimeoutMs ∈ [1500, 5000] ms（专载预留预算）
3. Quantitative Evaluation Matrix & Production Verification Checklist (Stage 443 · Topic 83 · P880 🎉 · 85th FAQ 🎉 · 885 Tests 🎉)
• Guardrail P879: evaluateSipRfc3312Rfc4032PreconditionUnmetAlertingGhostRingingGate => 0 ghost rings | [2, 2] dirs
• Guardrail P880 🎉: evaluateSipRfc3312VolteQci1ReservationTimeoutFallbackAnd580PreconditionFailureGate => 0 hung calls | [1500, 5000]ms
• Checklist: [x] [2,2]-Dir curr:qos Gate [x] 183+PRACK+UPDATE Flow [x] [1500,5000]ms Reservation Timer [x] Fast SIP 580 Teardown
